in_sanskrit.name: Pammi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Loving Mother
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pammi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pammi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Pam’ which means ‘loving’ and ‘mi’ which means ‘mother’. The name Pammi is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking feelings of love and nurturing.
